description:
Goal - To develop fully functional product for trading in Indian, USA and Crypto for Alphaedge users and partners. Here is a full product breakdown based on the actual code — organized into tracks you can drop straight into a project management tool like Linear, Jira, or Notion. --- ## Tracks & Tasks — AlphaEdge Journal --- ### Track 1: Trade Logging *The core data entry flow. Currently the modal renders but saves nothing.* - Wire "Save trade" button to persist trade to localStorage (entry, exit, qty, direction, symbol, strategy, rules followed, mistakes, notes) - Assign a unique trade ID (e.g. `ORB-38`) on save - Pre-fill today's date/time on open - Validate required fields before allowing step 2 - Confirm/dismiss toast on save success - Edit an existing trade (re-open dialog pre-filled) - Delete a trade with confirmation - Fix the duplicate-state bug on TradeDialog (done — deployed) --- ### Track 2: Calendar *Currently renders hardcoded mock data for March 2026.* - Read saved trades from storage and compute daily P&L per day - Color-code days from real data (green / red / flat / no-trade) - Show trade count and net P&L per cell from real data - Wire previous/next month navigation - Wire "Year" tab to show 12-month grid - Click a day → open a panel/drawer showing that day's trades - Mark weekends and market holidays correctly --- ### Track 3: Statistics *All numbers and charts are hardcoded SVG / static values.* - Compute real stats from trade storage (net P&L, win rate, avg win, avg loss) - Add period filter (this week / this month / YTD / all-time) - Render real equity curve from cumulative P&L over time - Break down P&L by strategy using real trade-strategy linkage - Compute profitability by hour-of-day from real entry timestamps - Add trade count, best day, worst day - Add R-multiple average (avg win / avg loss) --- ### Track 4: Journal *Sidebar and entry view are static placeholder content.* - Create a new journal entry (title, body, date, tags) - Persist journal entries to localStorage - Edit and delete entries - Rich text formatting (bold, italic, blockquote) or markdown - Tag management — create, assign, filter by tag - Link trades to a journal entry (show `ORB-38` chips below entry) - Auto-create a journal entry for each trading day when first trade is logged - Search entries --- ### Track 5: Trade AI (Claude Integration) *The UI is fully built — chat interface, typing dots, follow-up input. Nothing is wired.* - Connect input composer to Claude API - Send trade history as context in the system prompt - Stream the response token-by-token into the chat view - Auto-generate a weekly report on session start (summarise last 7 days) - Persist chat history in localStorage per session/date - "New report" button clears context and starts fresh - Suggested follow-up questions after each AI response --- ### Track 6: Playbook & Strategies *Strategies tab is fully functional (CRUD with localStorage). Other tabs are read-only.* - Add SVG diagrams for all 10 built-in strategies (currently only some have diagrams) - Allow users to attach a custom diagram/image to their strategy - Wire "Print" button — generate a clean print stylesheet or PDF export - Mistakes tab — persist checked state to localStorage so acknowledgements survive refresh - Rituals tab — add a "Mark as done today" checkbox per step, resetting daily - Strategies History tab — show per-strategy trade count, win rate, net P&L from real data - Allow reordering strategies via drag-and-drop --- ### Track 7: Trade History View *The "History" page is a placeholder —* `
Trade history view — Placeholder
`*.* - Build a table view listing all saved trades (date, symbol, direction, strategy, P&L) - Sort by date, P&L, strategy - Filter by strategy, direction (BUY/SELL), date range, win/loss - Click a row to expand trade detail (rules followed, mistakes, notes) - Bulk delete selected trades - Export to CSV --- ### Track 8: Data & Persistence *Everything currently uses localStorage with no sync.* - Design the trade data schema (fields, IDs, timestamps) - Abstract all storage reads/writes into a single data layer (so swapping to a backend is easy later) - Add export-all-data to JSON (backup) - Add import from JSON (restore) - Consider user accounts + cloud sync (Supabase / Firebase) for cross-device access --- ### Track 9: Engineering & Infrastructure *Currently using in-browser Babel compilation — fine for a prototype, not for production.* - Migrate to Vite (removes in-browser Babel, enables proper bundling and caching) - Add ESLint to catch duplicate-variable bugs at editor level (would have caught the blank-page bug) - Split `BibleData.jsx` into smaller files — it is one large data file - Set up proper CI (GitHub Actions: lint → build → deploy preview on PR) - Consolidate the two UI kits (app + marketing) into one repo structure with shared components - Add error boundaries so one broken component cannot blank the entire app --- ### Track 10: UI Polish *Small visual / UX gaps visible in the prototype.* - Empty states for all views when no trades have been logged yet - Loading skeletons for async data - Mobile-responsive layout (currently desktop-only) - Keyboard shortcut reference modal (⌘K is wired, others are not documented) - Dark mode toggle - Settings page (currently a dead sidebar link) - Feedback link (currently a dead sidebar link)
